title: Elp1 is required for myeloid differentiation and brain repopulation
title_zh: Elp1在髓系分化和脑再殖中必不可少
abstract: Haematopoietic stem and progenitor cell (HSPC) transplantation-mediated replacement of microglia-the reconstitution of the central nervous system microglial niche with donor-derived myeloid cells-represents a promising strategy for brain cell therapies1-7. However, the cell-intrinsic molecular regulators of HSPC-derived myeloid lineage commitment in the brain have remained largely uncharacterized. This is partially because the scarcity of primary HSPCs has rendered large-scale genetic interrogation intractable. Here we explored whether ex vivo expansion of primary cultured HSPCs (cHSPCs) enables unbiased genetic interrogation of haematopoietic differentiation. We established that cHSPCs can be genetically manipulated and readily differentiate into myeloid cells and repopulate microglia niches of the brain after transplantation. Moreover, primary neonatal astrocytes contained strong signals to induce myeloid specification of cHSPCs in vitro. To identify genes that regulate glia-induced myeloid differentiation, we successfully screened around 20,000 individual genetic perturbations and characterized genes involved in the regulation of cell signalling, cell cycle, mitochondrial function and protein translation. Among these genes was elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 1 (Elp1), which suppressed the unfolded protein response during myeloid specification and was essential for the generation but not maintenance of myeloid cells. Our work establishes a platform to investigate the molecular mechanisms of brain myeloid biology.
abstract_zh: 髓源性干细胞和前体细胞（HSPC）移植介导的微胶质细胞置换——即将供体来源的髓系细胞重构为中枢神经系统的微胶质细胞小环境——是脑细胞治疗的一种有前景的策略。然而，HSPC来源髓系谱系在脑内承诺的细胞内分子调节因子知之甚少。这部分是因为主要HSPCs的稀缺使得大规模基因功能探索变得不可行。在此，我们探讨了体外扩增的主要培养HSPCs（cHSPCs）是否能启用无偏的基因功能遗传探针。我们确立了cHSPCs可进行基因改造，并能易于分化为髓系细胞，并在移植后重新殖民脑微环境。此外，主要新生星形胶质细胞在体外含有强烈的信号，可诱导cHSPCs向髓系谱系分化。为了鉴定调控胶质诱导髓系分化的基因，我们成功筛选了约20,000个个体基因突变，并表征了参与信号转导、细胞周期、线粒体功能和蛋白质翻译的基因。其中，一个基因是elongator acetyltransferase complex subunit 1（Elp1），它在髓系谱系分化期间抑制了展开反应，且对髓系细胞的生成而非维持是必不可少的。我们的研究建立了一个平台，用于探索脑髓系生物学的分子机制。
